pending-clause.answer: Two triggers: 'terminated' (end of the ACCEPT statement, not run unit termination §2002:14.5.10, initial state or transfer of control) and 'EC-' (EC-DATA-INCOMPATIBLE). The rule leaves the choice implementor-defined; 2002 processes the condition under §2002:14.5.12.1.2/14.5.12.1.3 and §2002:14.5.12.2, whose text differs from 2023, but that difference is only observable when executable code for the screen ACCEPT exists. The screen ACCEPT is declined at --std 2002 (COBOL1707) and §2002:3.1.5 lets the implementor produce no code, so no exception path is reached; scope and evidence unchanged.
